formula.name: Osmanthus Aromatic Fougère Luxe — 30mL EdP
formula.body:
# Osmanthus Aromatic Fougère Luxe — 30mL EdP

## Character
Osmanthus-centered aromatic fougère with dark luxury depth. Lavender and tonkarome form the frame. Osmanthus absolute carries apricot-tea-leather. Tobacco boosted to a structural bridge. Nagar Motha provides woody-smoke mineral. IBQ at trace adds leather darkness. Labdanum adds resinous warmth. Rose de Mai mediates lavender→tonka. Alpha Ionone deepens the ionone backbone. No birch tar — darkness from tobacco + nagar motha + IBQ. 22 materials, focused, modern luxury.

**Family**: Aromatic Fougère (dark luxury)
**Materials**: 22
**Concentration**: ~14% EdP

## Formula

| # | Ingredient | Dilution | Amount (µL) |
|---|-----------|----------|:---:|
| **🌅 Top** |
| 1 | Bergamot FCF | neat | 100 |
| 2 | Ethyl Linalool | neat | 25 |
| **💕 Heart** |
| 3 | Lavender HA | neat | 20 |
| 4 | Osmanthus Absolute | 10% in DPG | 700 |
| 5 | Rose de Mai Absolute | 10% in DPG | 200 |
| 6 | Hedione HC | neat | 400 |
| 7 | Gamma Decalactone | neat | 80 |
| 8 | Beta Ionone | 1% in TEC | 80 |
| 9 | Eugenol | 1% in DPG | 30 |
| **🪵 Base** |
| 10 | Tobacco Absolute | 10% in DPG | 200 |
| 11 | Nagar Motha Oil | neat | 100 |
| 12 | Tonkarome | 10% in DPG | 200 |
| 13 | Iso E Super | neat | 200 |
| 14 | Labdanum Resinoid | 10% in DPG | 150 |
| 15 | Alpha Ionone | neat | 80 |
| 16 | Isobutyl Quinoline | 10% | 50 |
| 17 | Ebanol | neat | 60 |
| 18 | Timberol | neat | 80 |
| 19 | Ambrofix | 30% w/v | 80 |
| 20 | Romandolide | neat | 200 |
| 21 | Ethylene Brassylate | neat | 200 |
| 22 | Benzyl Salicylate | neat | 250 |

**Concentrate**: 3,485 µL (11.6% of 30mL EdP — needs scaling to ~4,500 for full EdP)

diagnostics: ℹ Very high reservoir fraction — excellent blooming potential
ℹ Dense lipophilic base — deep skin absorption, slow evolution
✓ Strong fabric substantivity — will last well on clothing
Blooming materials (Iso-E-effect): Ambrofix, Ambrofix, Romandolide, Romandolide, Ethylene Brassylate
✓ >80% of formula mass is hedonically pleasant
Perceptual channels: 16 (9 cross-adaptation groups + 7 solo materials) from 22 ingredients
Channel model: 15 materials collapsed into 9 group channels (Laing ceiling applies to channels, not ingredients)
• ionone_family: Alpha Ionone, Beta Ionone (2 → 1 channel)
• woody_amber: Iso E Super, Timberol, Ebanol, Ambrofix (4 → 1 channel)
Genetic anosmia risk: 3.2% of formula mass affected by OR variants
✓ All profiled materials within positive character range
ℹ Near character-shift boundary: Ethyl Linalool — small dose changes could shift perceived character
Mid-field: Ethyl Linalool, Lavender HA, Osmanthus Absolute, Gamma Decalactone, Beta Ionone
Near-field: Rose de Mai Absolute, Labdanum Resinoid, Romandolide, Ethylene Brassylate
